lines.zh: 我侧着身子，从石缝里挤过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze between the stones.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮着岩壁，声音很轻。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the rock wall, hardly a sound.

lines.zh: 岔路太多，我先走左边这条。
lines.en: Too many forks; I take the left crack first.

lines.zh: 爪子先探路，身子才跟上。
lines.en: The claws test the path before the body follows.

lines.zh: 岩缝太窄，我侧着身子挤进去。
lines.en: The crack is narrow; I squeeze in sideways.

lines.zh: 我横着走，比直着更快。
lines.en: Walking sideways is faster than walking straight.

lines.zh: 头顶岩层压得很低。
lines.en: The stone ceiling hangs very low here.

lines.zh: 我数着缝隙，找能钻进去的。
lines.en: I count the cracks and pick one I can enter.

lines.zh: 六条腿各有各的方向。
lines.en: Each of my six legs picks its own direction.

lines.zh: 深层的风从洞里灌出来。
lines.en: Deep-land air pushes out of the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，影子很小。
lines.en: I hug the ground, and my shadow stays small.

lines.zh: 爪尖在岩面留下一道白痕。
lines.en: My claw tips leave a pale scratch on the rock.

lines.zh: 走慢点，甲壳会被磨薄。
lines.en: Slow down, or my shell will wear thin.

lines.zh: 我认得这条缝，昨天躲过这里。
lines.en: I know this crack; I hid here yesterday.

lines.zh: 我在石缝口停一下，听听里面。
lines.en: I stop at a fissure mouth and listen inside.

lines.zh: 我拖着甲壳，钻进更窄的缝。
lines.en: I drag my shell into an even narrower crack.

lines.zh: 我缩在石缝里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I tuck into the crevice with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 壳上有块旧裂痕，一直没长好。
lines.en: An old crack in my shell never healed right.

lines.zh: 我在数洞顶滴水的声音。
lines.en: I am counting the water drops from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这只爪子比另一只钝了。
lines.en: This claw has gone duller than the other one.

lines.zh: 石块底下有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something is crawling under that loose stone.

lines.zh: 我把自己抹进岩壁的颜色里。
lines.en: I rub myself into the colour of the wall.

lines.zh: 太安静了，我连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: It is too quiet; I even soften my breathing.

lines.zh: 我在等一只虫子从缝里出来。
lines.en: I wait for a grub to come out of the gap.

lines.zh: 壳底下发痒，是要脱壳了。
lines.en: My shell itches beneath; a moult is coming.

lines.zh: 我试着把爪子收进壳里。
lines.en: I try to pull my claws back under the shell.

lines.zh: 这块石头是暖的，我趴一会。
lines.en: This stone is warm; I lie on it a while.

lines.zh: 我在听远处有没有脚步声。
lines.en: I listen for footsteps somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 藏身处要够窄，才没人进得来。
lines.en: A hiding place must be narrow to keep others out.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸出缝外探一探。
lines.en: I push my feelers past the crack and test the air.

lines.zh: 岩石缝里，我横着钻过去。
lines.en: I scuttle sideways through the rock crack.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，影子把我盖住了。
lines.en: You crouch, and your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 你手里没有网，我不太怕。
lines.en: You hold no net, so I am not very afraid.

lines.zh: 岩石缝里，我横着钻。
lines.en: I sidle through cracks in the rock.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块石头是我的屋顶。
lines.en: The stone you stand on is my roof.

lines.zh: 你在数我的腿吗？六条。
lines.en: Are you counting my legs? There are six.

lines.zh: 别用手抓我，爪子会划你。
lines.en: Do not grab me; my claws will cut you.

lines.zh: 你的影子挪开了，我才敢动。
lines.en: Your shadow moves away, and only then do I stir.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，上次也是你。
lines.en: I know your smell; you were here before.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我把自己缩小。
lines.en: When you look, I make myself smaller.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳了，裂了一道。
lines.en: You stepped on my shell and cracked it.

lines.zh: 疼，我的腿缩了一半。
lines.en: It hurts; half my legs have pulled in.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，我缩进石缝里去。
lines.en: My shell cracks; I shrink into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从缝里打出来了。
lines.en: That blow knocked me out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 我的爪子松开了，抓不住地。
lines.en: My claws let go and cannot grip the ground.

lines.zh: 甲壳碎片掉在地上，是我的。
lines.en: Chitin flakes fall to the ground, and they are mine.

lines.zh: 我还站得住，只是慢一点。
lines.en: I can still stand, only slower now.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的触角，很疼。
lines.en: You broke my feeler, and it stings badly.

lines.zh: 我要回洞里，把伤藏起来。
lines.en: I want my burrow to hide this wound in.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，别再来。
lines.en: I will remember this blow; do not repeat it.

lines.zh: 你指缝掉下的碎屑，我能吃吗？
lines.en: The crumb between your fingers, may I have it?

lines.zh: 石缝里的苔藓比碎屑香。
lines.en: The moss in the crack smells better than crumbs.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: Shake it once, and I shuffle one step closer.

lines.zh: 我不抢，你把东西放在石头上。
lines.en: I will not grab; set it down on the stone.

lines.zh: 那块东西的味道钻进我的触角。
lines.en: That smell crawls right into my feelers.

lines.zh: 我伸出爪子，只伸一半。
lines.en: I reach out a claw, only halfway.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我才敢靠过去。
lines.en: Step back a little, and I will dare come near.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但壳太重跑不快。
lines.en: I am hungry, but my shell is heavy and I am slow.

lines.zh: 这个比石缝里的虫好吃多了。
lines.en: This tastes far better than the grubs in cracks.

lines.zh: 吃完我就回洞里，不赖着。
lines.en: Once I eat I go back to the hole, no lingering.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我的爪子缩了一下。
lines.en: You kicked me, and my claws pulled in.

lines.zh: 别用脚推，壳会撞在岩壁上。
lines.en: Do not push with your foot; my shell hits the wall.

lines.zh: 我横着躲开，还是被你碰到。
lines.en: I dodge sideways and still you touch me.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的脚踝才该小心。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your ankle should be careful.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我差点翻过去。
lines.en: That bump nearly rolled me onto my back.

lines.zh: 石缝太窄，我们都过不去。
lines.en: The crack is too narrow for either of us.

lines.zh: 我退后两步，把路让给你。
lines.en: I back off two steps and yield the path.

lines.zh: 你靴底的纹路印在我壳上了。
lines.en: Your boot tread is printed on my shell.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就钻进石头下面。
lines.en: Once more, and I go under the stone.

lines.zh: 我的尖爪勾住了你的裤脚。
lines.en: My sharp claw has caught on your trouser hem.

lines.zh: 我敲壳三下，对面回了四下。
lines.en: I tap my shell three times; the answer is four.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一条缝里，谁也不动。
lines.en: We crowd into one crack and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 她的爪比我短，走路更稳。
lines.en: Her claws are shorter than mine, and steadier.

lines.zh: 我把找到的暖石头分给她。
lines.en: I share the warm stone I found with her.

lines.zh: 两只蚂蚁并排，缝就太窄了。
lines.en: Two ants side by side make the crack too narrow.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰她的壳。
lines.en: I touch her shell with my feelers.

lines.zh: 脱壳的时候，她会守在洞口。
lines.en: While I moult, she keeps watch at the entrance.

lines.zh: 我们的甲壳颜色几乎一样。
lines.en: Our chitin is almost exactly the same colour.

lines.zh: 明年这条缝里会多几只小的。
lines.en: Next year this crack will hold a few small ones.

lines.zh: 她走在前面，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She walks ahead, and I follow behind her.

lines.zh: 这块甲壳是我掉的，还给我。
lines.en: That chitin is mine, I shed it; give it back.

lines.zh: 你捡起我的旧爪，我就跟着你。
lines.en: You pick up my old claw, so I follow you.

lines.zh: 石头底下那颗，是我藏的。
lines.en: The one under the stone is what I buried.

lines.zh: 你手指太粗，夹不住这种东西。
lines.en: Your fingers are too thick to hold that thing.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进洞里，你别抢。
lines.en: I drag it into the hole; do not take it.

lines.zh: 这块亮的，换我的碎屑行吗？
lines.en: Will that shiny thing trade for my crumbs?

lines.zh: 我举起来给你看，又收回去。
lines.en: I lift it for you to see, then take it back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，先碰到算谁的。
lines.en: Whatever falls is theirs who touches it first.

lines.zh: 你捡的那个扎手，小心。
lines.en: The one you picked is sharp; be careful.

lines.zh: 我用两只爪子抱着，走不快了。
lines.en: I carry it in both claws and cannot walk fast.

lines.zh: 那边的影子动了，我盯住它。
lines.en: That shadow moved; I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 石头后面有爪子声，不是我的。
lines.en: Claws scrape behind the rock, and they are not mine.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了石子，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a pebble; I heard it clearly.

lines.zh: 三条腿的虫子，我够得着。
lines.en: A three-legged grub, and it is within my reach.

lines.zh: 岩缝里伸出的爪子，不止我的。
lines.en: The claws in that crevice aren't only mine.

lines.zh: 它挡在洞口，我得挪开它。
lines.en: It blocks my burrow, so I must shift it.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢那个发光的东西靠近。
lines.en: I do not want that glowing thing coming closer.

lines.zh: 目标很小，我一次就能夹住。
lines.en: The target is small; one pinch will hold it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，甲壳贴住地面。
lines.en: I flatten down, shell pressed to the ground.

lines.zh: 它先动的，不是我。
lines.en: It moved first, not me.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，先夹那条。
lines.en: I watch its legs and go for that one first.

lines.zh: 我夹着石粒，慢慢往你脚边挪。
lines.en: Carrying a pebble in my claws, I edge toward your feet.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的爪子就抬起来。
lines.en: When it moves, my claw comes up.

lines.zh: 我绕石缝走，想从侧面过去。
lines.en: I circle the crack, meaning to come from the side.

lines.zh: 它的壳比我的薄，我看得出来。
lines.en: Its shell is thinner than mine; I can tell.

lines.zh: 别急，等它背对我。
lines.en: Not yet; wait until its back is turned.

lines.zh: 我的尖爪对准了它的关节。
lines.en: My sharp claw is aimed at its joint.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，壳就不会响。
lines.en: Slow my breath, and my shell will not rattle.

lines.zh: 它退到岩壁边，没有路了。
lines.en: It backs to the wall, and there is no way out.

lines.zh: 这一次我要一次夹断。
lines.en: This time I mean to cut it in one pinch.

lines.zh: 爪子下去，它的壳裂了一道。
lines.en: The claw lands, and its shell splits open.

lines.zh: 我夹住它的腿，不松。
lines.en: I clamp its leg and will not let go.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我的爪更尖。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, but my claws are sharper.

lines.zh: 我的尖爪掐进你的脚踝。
lines.en: My pointed claw pinches into your ankle.

lines.zh: 碎石溅起来，打在我壳上。
lines.en: Gravel sprays up and strikes my shell.

lines.zh: 我横着扑过去，撞在它侧面。
lines.en: I lunge sideways and hit its flank.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我勾住它的后腿。
lines.en: It tries to run; I hook its hind leg.

lines.zh: 我的爪子卡住了，得拔出来。
lines.en: My claw is stuck and I must pull it free.

lines.zh: 岩石缝里夹住的力气都使上了。
lines.en: Every bit of strength from those rock crevices.

lines.zh: 它不动了，我退开两步。
lines.en: It stops moving, and I back off two steps.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里爬出来，全是灰。
lines.en: I crawl out of the crack covered in grey dust.

lines.zh: 深层太暗，我先适应一下。
lines.en: The Deeplands are dark; let me adjust first.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁后面，刚好有个洞。
lines.en: There is just room for a burrow behind this wall.

lines.zh: 我刚脱过壳，新甲还是软的。
lines.en: I have just moulted, and the new shell is still soft.

lines.zh: 地面在震，是什么大东西。
lines.en: The ground shakes; something large is near.

lines.zh: 我挑了条最窄的缝出生。
lines.en: I chose the narrowest crack to be born in.

lines.zh: 石头缝里的空气是凉的。
lines.en: The air inside the stone crack is cold.

lines.zh: 第一次出来，我先贴着墙走。
lines.en: My first time out, so I keep to the wall.

lines.zh: 上面有光，那不是深层的光。
lines.en: There is light above, and it is not Deepland light.

lines.zh: 我把爪子磨了磨，才敢往外走。
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on stone before going out.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我往缝里钻。
lines.en: The fire heats my shell; I dig deeper into the crack.

lines.zh: 从岩壁掉下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the wall and land on my shell.

lines.zh: 水灌进缝里，我的腿划不动。
lines.en: Water fills the crack and my legs cannot paddle.

lines.zh: 碎石全砸下来，我缩成一团。
lines.en: The blast drops gravel, and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边的石头上。
lines.en: An arrow pins itself into the stone beside me.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进壳缝，凉得刺骨。
lines.en: That light seeps into my shell seam, cold to the bone.

lines.zh: 缝里没有虫，我空了两天。
lines.en: No grubs in this crack; I have been empty two days.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着岩层传下来，壳在抖。
lines.en: Thunder travels down the stone, and my shell trembles.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，爪子抓空了。
lines.en: Nothing below, and my claws close on empty air.
